name: Tanggalanku Kalender Indonesia
author: tanggalanku.id

sections.description:
Tanggalanku Kalender Indonesia is the official Indonesian calendar widget plugin for WordPress. Easily embed responsive monthly calendars in your sidebars, footers, or within posts and pages using the [tanggalanku_calendar] shortcode.

Features:
* Official National Holidays & Collective Leave: Verified directly against official joint ministerial decrees (SKB 3 Menteri).
* Automatic Updates: If the Indonesian government revises collective leave dates, the calendar updates automatically via Edge CDN without requiring a plugin update.
* Javanese Weton Market Cycle: Displays the 5-day pasaran cycle (Legi, Pahing, Pon, Wage, Kliwon) with 100% astronomical accuracy.
* Islamic Hijri Calendar: Accurate lunar dates aligned with Indonesian Ministry of Religious Affairs (Kemenag RI) criteria.
* Chinese Zodiac & Western Zodiac: Optional display of lunar Chinese zodiac and Western astrological signs.
* Total Style Isolation (Shadow DOM): Encapsulated CSS ensures the widget will never conflict with or break your WordPress theme.
* Ultra Lightweight: Less than 13 KB raw (~4 KB gzip) bundled locally and loaded asynchronously to keep Core Web Vitals green.
* 100% Free & Privacy-Friendly: No ads, no tracking cookies, no user registration, and no API keys required.

External Services

This plugin connects to external REST endpoints from Tanggalanku.id solely to fetch official public holiday dataset updates:
* Service: Tanggalanku Holiday API (https://tanggalanku.id/api/v1/). The interactive calendar JavaScript is bundled locally inside this plugin to comply with WordPress.org guidelines (Guideline 8).
* Data Privacy: No personally identifiable information (PII), cookies, or visitor data is transmitted or collected. Requests only retrieve public holiday JSON datasets.
* Terms of Service: https://tanggalanku.id/tentang
* Privacy Policy: https://tanggalanku.id/kebijakan-privasi

Shortcode & Block Options

The [tanggalanku_calendar] shortcode and Gutenberg block support:
* mode: Preset type: clean (National), nusantara (Weton + Hijri), or lengkap (Full: Weton, Hijri, Shio, Zodiac). Default: clean (Shortcode) / nusantara (Block).
* theme: auto (follows browser/system theme), light, or dark. Default: auto.
* width: Maximum width of the calendar container (e.g. 100%, 500px, 650px). Default: 100%.
* libur: true or false to toggle national holidays and collective leave.
* weton: true or false to explicitly toggle Javanese pasaran.
* hijri: true or false to explicitly toggle Islamic Hijri dates.
* shio: true or false to explicitly toggle Chinese zodiac signs.
* zodiak: true or false to explicitly toggle Western zodiac signs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tanggalanku-calendar folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via Plugins > Add New by searching for “Tanggalanku”.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the calendar to your site:
    • Gutenberg Block (Recommended): Click +, search for Tanggalanku, and insert the Tanggalanku Kalender block. Customize mode, theme, and width via the right sidebar panel!
    • Classic Editor: Click the calendar icon on the editor toolbar to open the popup GUI and insert your calendar.
    • Shortcode: Type [tanggalanku_calendar mode="nusantara"] anywhere in your post or page.
    • Sidebar / Footer: Go to Appearance > Widgets and add the Tanggalanku Calendar widget.

Panduan visual lengkap: Cara Memasang Kalender Indonesia di WordPress.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin completely free?

Yes, this plugin is 100% free and open-source licensed under GPLv2+.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The core script is under 14 KB (~4 KB gzip) and is enqueued asynchronously in the footer so it never blocks page rendering.

Does it support dark mode?

Yes. You can configure theme="dark", theme="light", or theme="auto" to automatically match the visitor’s device preferences.

How do I change the calendar size?

Use the width parameter in the shortcode (e.g., [tanggalanku_calendar width="500px"]) or the Width setting in the Gutenberg block sidebar. The calendar height is automatically calculated to adapt responsively to every screen size.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Enqueued TinyMCE admin editor styles via wp_enqueue_style() on admin_enqueue_scripts per WordPress.org guideline compliance.
  • Extracted inline CSS into dedicated stylesheet assets/css/editor.css.

1.1.0

  • Added native Gutenberg Block (tanggalanku/calendar) with live block editor preview and InspectorControls sidebar settings.
  • Added Classic Editor (TinyMCE) toolbar button with Tanggalanku terracotta icon and popup modal GUI for inserting calendars.
  • Added custom configuration mode with granular feature toggles (libur, weton, hijri, shio, zodiak).
  • Added target year and month parameters in Gutenberg block, Classic Editor GUI, and shortcode.
  • Fixed preset immutability when switching between preset modes and custom toggles.
  • Updated bundled widget assets to match latest release.

1.0.1

  • Added alias shortcodes: [tanggalanku_kalender], [tanggalanku_kalender_indonesia], and [tanggalanku_widget].
  • Enhanced automated release packaging to produce both standard and versioned zip archives.
  • Cleaned up plugin header metadata according to WordPress.org guidelines.

1.0.0

  • Initial official release of Tanggalanku Calendar.
  • Shortcode [tanggalanku_calendar] and classic sidebar widget (Tanggalanku_Calendar_Widget) support.
  • Local asset bundling with Shadow DOM style isolation.
  • Preset support: Clean (National), Nusantara (Weton & Hijri), and Lengkap (Full).
